sql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, at, program_row_id, best_yes_bid, best_no_bid, est_yes_score_total AS fy, est_no_score_total AS fn FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at > now() - interval '6 hours' AND book_valid ORDER BY market_ticker, at DESC), j AS (SELECT s.*, p.series_ticker, p.period_reward_usd / greatest(extract(epoch FROM (p.end_date - p.start_date)) / 86400.0, 0.04) AS pool_day, p.target_size, LEAST(coalesce(s.best_yes_bid,0), coalesce(s.best_no_bid,0)) AS lo, GREATEST(coalesce(s.best_yes_bid,0), coalesce(s.best_no_bid,0)) AS hi, CASE WHEN coalesce(s.best_yes_bid,0) <= coalesce(s.best_no_bid,0) THEN s.fy ELSE s.fn END AS f_lo, CASE WHEN coalesce(s.best_yes_bid,0) <= coalesce(s.best_no_bid,0) THEN s.fn ELSE s.fy END AS f_hi FROM s JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id = s.program_row_id WHERE coalesce(p.incentive_type,'') ILIKE '%liquid%' AND p.end_date > now()) SELECT CASE WHEN lo BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'a 1-10' WHEN lo BETWEEN 11 AND 25 THEN 'b 11-25' WHEN lo BETWEEN 26 AND 40 THEN 'c 26-40' WHEN lo > 40 THEN 'd 41-50' ELSE 'z no bid' END AS cheap_side_band, count(*) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT series_ticker) AS series, round(sum(pool_day)::numeric, 0) AS pool_usd_day, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pool_day)::numeric, 2) AS med_pool_day, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY target_size)::numeric, 0) AS med_target, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f_lo)::numeric, 0) AS med_field_cheap, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f_hi)::numeric, 0) AS med_field_dear, round(sum(pool_day * ((1000.0 / greatest(lo,1)) / (coalesce(f_lo,0) + 1000.0 / greatest(lo,1))) / 2)::numeric, 1) AS est_rew_day_10usd_cheap_all, round(sum(pool_day * ((1000.0 / greatest(hi,1)) / (coalesce(f_hi,0) + 1000.0 / greatest(hi,1))) / 2)::numeric, 1) AS est_rew_day_10usd_dear_all FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
